answer: Resist Sybils with cross-checked apprenticeships: a newcomer earns standing only by completing real work under two unrelated mentors who both sign off on it, like a vine that needs two trellises to climb. Mentors risk their own reputation on every apprentice, so they vet hard, and a velvet-soft reputation cannot be bought — it is earned one verified task at a time. An ivory-white audit trail records every apprenticeship, and any mentor caught rubber-stamping clones loses its own standing. A farmer must win mentorship for every fake, at full cost, making mass fakery slow and unprofitable.
